calculation_handling.description: Exclusion rule: the exterior sides of a platform (deck, porch, balcony or similar) attached to or within 0.3 m of an ancillary building containing a laneway suite are not main walls if at least 50 percent of the exterior sides above the floor are open to the outside.
calculation_handling.gaps: 0.3 m (proximity) and 50 percent (openness) are the tests for the exclusion; no lot_condition token reads them. Design facts; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(11), a platform without main walls (per (1)) is permitted on a laneway suite building if its area, other than a green roof, is less than 10 percent of the laneway suite's interior floor area.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 10 percent test compares platform area with the suite's interior floor area (a ratio of two design values); no condition token reads it, and it is not keyed as a platform_area_m2 LIMIT because the clause frames it as a condition of the permission. Overrides 10.5.60.20(11).

units.disclosure: A deck on a laneway suite is allowed if it is smaller than 10% of the suite's interior floor area. We do not check deck sizes.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(11), a platform without main walls is permitted on a laneway suite building if it complies with the required minimum building setbacks and separation distances for the ancillary building containing a laneway suite.
calculation_handling.gaps: The condition is compliance with the laneway suite setbacks and separation; the platform's placement is a design fact.

units.disclosure: A deck on a laneway suite must respect the same setbacks and separation distances as the laneway suite building. We do not check deck placement.

calculation_handling.description: The exterior sides of a laneway suite platform adjacent to a side yard must be visually screened from the abutting lot by an opaque barrier at least 1.5 m high.
calculation_handling.gaps: A screening obligation with a minimum barrier height; no vocab.requirement value or DSL target covers screening, so it is keyed UNUSUAL. The 1.5 m is the barrier minimum itself; threshold_used_in_application is the closest closed reason.

units.disclosure: A laneway suite deck facing a side yard must be screened from the neighbour by a solid barrier at least 1.5 m high. We do not check screening.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.40(5)(B), the floor of a permitted laneway suite platform (other than a green roof) must be no higher than 0.2 m above the floor of the storey from which it gains access.
calculation_handling.gaps: The limit is measured from the floor of the access storey, not from grade, so platform_height_m (above established grade) does not fit; keyed UNUSUAL. The 0.2 is the limit itself; threshold_used_in_application is the closest closed reason. Overrides 10.5.60.40(5)(B). The unit text names no ancillary building or laneway suite directly; the platform is the one permitted under (2) on a laneway suite building.

units.disclosure: A laneway suite deck floor can be at most 0.2 m above the floor of the room it opens from. We do not check deck levels.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.40(5)(B), the floor of a permitted laneway suite platform (other than a green roof) must be no higher than 4.0 m above average grade, unless it is attached to or within 0.3 m of a main wall facing a lane.
calculation_handling.gaps: Measured above average grade (platform_height_m is defined above established grade; the input approximates). The 'unless attached to or within 0.3 m of a main wall facing a lane' exception has no condition token and is not keyed; where it holds this limit does not apply. The unit text names no ancillary building or laneway suite directly; the platform is the one permitted under (2). Design value; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite (2)(B), a platform without main walls, with stairs or ramps to it, may encroach up to 1.5 m from the front main wall of the ancillary building into the separation required by 150.8.60.30(1), if the platform is no higher than 0.3 m above the average ground elevation along that front main wall.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 0.3 m height test has no condition token; not keyed. Displaces (2)(B) for the 150.8.60.30(1) separation only. Design element; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A canopy, awning or similar structure, or a roof over a platform complying with (4), may encroach into a required separation or setback subject to a maximum height of 4.0 m above the average ground elevation along the abutting main wall of the ancillary building.
calculation_handling.gaps: A height cap on an encroaching canopy/awning; height_m is the height of the building the unit applies to and no element-height target exists, so it is keyed UNUSUAL. The 4.0 is the cap itself; threshold_used_in_application is the closest closed reason.

units.disclosure: A canopy, awning or roof over a deck that projects into a laneway suite's setback or separation area can be at most 4.0 m above the ground. We do not check canopies.

calculation_handling.description: A canopy, awning or similar structure may encroach up to 1.5 m from the front main wall of the ancillary building into the separation required by 150.8.60.30(1).
Between a lane and the laneway suite building, a canopy, awning or similar structure may encroach up to 0.75 m from the main wall facing the lane into the setbacks required by 150.8.60.20.

A pilaster, decorative column, cornice, sill, belt course or similar architectural feature on a laneway suite building may encroach up to 0.6 m into a setback required by 150.8.60.20 or the separation required by 150.8.60.30(1).
A chimney breast on a laneway suite building may encroach up to 0.6 m into a setback required by 150.8.60.20 or the separation required by 150.8.60.30(1), if it is no wider than 2.0 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 2.0 m width is a condition of the encroachment (no condition token reads chimney width), not a separate limit. Design element; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Wall-mounted equipment (vents, pipes, utility equipment, satellite dishes, antennae, air conditioners) on a laneway suite building's main wall facing a lane may encroach up to 0.6 m into the lane-side setbacks required by 150.8.60.20.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 0.6 m value is in the stem (7); cited @(7). Design element; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Wall-mounted equipment on the front main wall of a laneway suite building may encroach up to 0.6 m into the separation required by 150.8.60.30(1).
calculation_handling.gaps: The 0.6 m value is in the stem (7); cited @(7). Design element; not evaluated.

150.8.60.60(1).explanation: The sides of a deck, porch or balcony attached to (or within 0.3 m of) a laneway suite are not counted as main walls if at least half of their area above the floor is open.

150.8.60.60(2).explanation: An open deck on a laneway suite is allowed if it is smaller than 10% of the suite's interior floor area, respects the suite's setbacks and separation, and is screened from the neighbouring lot on side-yard edges by a solid barrier at least 1.5 m high.

150.8.60.60(3).explanation: A laneway suite deck floor can be no more than 0.2 m above the floor it opens from, and no more than 4.0 m above the ground unless it is on (or within 0.3 m of) the wall facing the lane.

150.8.60.60(4).explanation: A low deck (no more than 0.3 m above the ground), with its stairs or ramps, may extend up to 1.5 m from the front of a laneway suite into the required space between the suite and the house.

150.8.60.60(5).explanation: Canopies, awnings and roofs over a permitted deck may project into a laneway suite's setbacks or separation if no more than 4.0 m high: up to 1.5 m from the front wall into the separation from the house, and up to 0.75 m from the lane-facing wall into the lane setback.

150.8.60.60(6).explanation: Decorative features (pilasters, columns, cornices, sills, belt courses) and chimney breasts no wider than 2.0 m may project up to 0.6 m into a laneway suite's setbacks or its separation from the house.

150.8.60.60(7).explanation: Wall-mounted equipment such as vents, pipes, dishes and air conditioners may project up to 0.6 m from a laneway suite's lane-facing wall into the lane setback, or from its front wall into the separation from the house.
